name: print-social-banner-navy-dashed-icon-grid-headline
title: Navy banner with dashed-outline icon rows framing a headline
whatItIs: A wide navy banner with a huge centered headline, flanked above and below by rows of five dashed-outline icon boxes representing planning-related concepts.
whatItMeans: Framing bold type between symmetric icon rows gives a text-only headline extra visual structure and implies a fuller feature set without adding real complexity.
techniques: frame a large centered headline with symmetric rows of small icon tiles above and below
use dashed/dotted outline strokes on icons for a lighter, technical feel than solid fills
limit accent colors to small dot details so the navy/white/orange palette stays disciplined
bestFor: content calendar or planning tool marketing

vocabulary.definition: a horizontal series of small pictograms used to suggest a feature set or process steps
